name: 44502 · Youngstown, OH
findings: ZIP 44502 (Youngstown) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44502 (Youngstown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44502 (Youngstown) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
